fullPassage: Before the 16th century, there were no sizing systems for clothing whatsoever. Then, in 1589, one of the first written works related to the tailoring of clothes was published. This may have represented the beginnings of modern measurement standards. At the start of the 19th century, however, clothes were still being measured individually. It was a series of wars that finally led to the establishment of universal sizing, due to a sudden increase in the demand for military uniforms. By the end of the century, men's clothing was being sold in standardized sizes that didn't require any additional measurements. Women's clothing, however, took longer to change, as it was generally much more close-fitting. It wasn't until the early 20th century that ready-to-wear women's clothing became popular.

det.korean: supply=공급 / comfort=편안함 / demand=수요(어떤 상품·서비스에 대한 구매자의 강한 필요나 욕구) / budget=예산
det.analysis:
① supply: 공급 — 파는 쪽이 내놓는 양이라 반대 개념
② comfort: 편안함 — 의미 다름
③ demand: 수요 — 구매자의 강한 필요·욕구 ←정답
④ budget: 예산 — 쓸 수 있는 돈이라 의미 다름
det.tip: buyers + strong need/desire for a product = 수요(demand)

questions.passage: At the start of the 19th century, clothes were still being measured individually. By the end of the century, men's clothing was being __________ (sell) in standardized sizes that didn't require any additional measurements.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: sell(동사: 팔다) → sold. 'was being + 과거분사'는 '~되고 있었다'라는 과거진행 수동태
det.analysis: 동사 sell을 과거분사 sold로 바꿔요. 'was being sold'는 'be동사 + being + 과거분사' 구조의 과거진행 수동태로 '팔리고 있었다'라는 뜻이에요. 옷이 판매되는(파는 게 아니라 팔리는) 대상이라 수동태가 필요하고, 그래서 원형 sell이 아니라 과거분사 sold를 써요.
det.tip: was being + 과거분사 = ~되고 있었다(과거진행 수동태). sell → sold

questions.passage: Then, in 1589, one of the first written works related to the tailoring of clothes was published. This may have __________ (represent) the beginnings of modern measurement standards.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: represent(동사: 나타내다) → represented. 'may have + 과거분사'는 '~했을지도 모른다'라는 과거의 추측
det.analysis: 동사 represent를 과거분사 represented로 바꿔요. 'may have represented'는 '조동사 may + have + 과거분사' 구조로 '~을 나타냈을지도 모른다'라는 과거에 대한 추측을 나타내요. 그래서 원형 represent가 아니라 과거분사 represented가 필요해요.
det.tip: may have + 과거분사 = ~했을지도 모른다. represent → represented

questions.passage: Before the 16th century, there were no sizing systems for clothing whatsoever. Then, in 1589, one of the first written works related to the tailoring of clothes was published. This may have represented the beginnings of modern measurement standards. At the start of the 19th century, however, clothes were still being measured individually. It was a series of wars that finally led to the establishment of universal sizing, due to a sudden increase in the demand for __________. By the end of the century, men's clothing was being sold in standardized sizes that didn't require any additional measurements. Women's clothing, however, took longer to change, as it was generally much more close-fitting. It wasn't until the early 20th century that ready-to-wear women's clothing became popular.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: military uniforms=군복 / winter coats=겨울 코트 / school bags=책가방 / leather shoes=가죽 구두
det.analysis:
① military uniforms: 전쟁으로 급증한 수요의 대상 = 군복 ←정답
② winter coats: 겨울 코트? 전쟁과 직접 연결 안 됨
③ school bags: 책가방? 문맥 무관
④ leather shoes: 가죽 구두? 문맥 무관
det.tip: 전쟁 → a sudden increase in the demand for __________ → 군복(military uniforms)

questions.passage: Before the 16th century, there were no sizing systems for clothing whatsoever. Then, in 1589, one of the first written works related to the tailoring of clothes was published. This may have represented the beginnings of modern measurement standards. At the start of the 19th century, however, clothes were still being measured individually. It was a series of wars that finally led to the establishment of universal sizing, due to a sudden increase in the demand for military uniforms. By the end of the century, men's clothing was being sold in standardized sizes that didn't require any __________. Women's clothing, however, took longer to change, as it was generally much more close-fitting. It wasn't until the early 20th century that ready-to-wear women's clothing became popular.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: personal tailors=개인 재단사 / special permission=특별 허가 / expensive tools=값비싼 도구 / additional measurements=추가 측정
det.analysis:
① personal tailors: 개인 재단사? 표준 사이즈가 없애준 것은 사람이 아니라 측정 과정
② special permission: 특별 허가? 문맥 무관
③ expensive tools: 값비싼 도구? 문맥 무관
④ additional measurements: 표준화된 사이즈라 더 이상 필요 없어진 것 = 추가 측정 ←정답
det.tip: standardized sizes that didn't require any __________ → 추가 측정(additional measurements)
